description:
Owner's law (2026-07-02): follow_up is an anti-northstar SMELL. Work runs for exactly two reasons: a consumer WAITS on a named fact/product (pull), or a CHANGED REVISION wakes a recorded reader. Owner's sharpening: "if a push-based / pass-based idea is being smuggled back in under a different name, that's a violation of the spirit of the pull/demand based approach. period." A load-bearing push never gets blessed; the fix is extending the pull mechanism.

DOC ALIGNMENT: the blanket rule is pull-based.html's Non-negotiable; northstar.html still tolerates follow_up for legacy jobs -- this arc is the doc-anticipated retirement of that tolerance (update northstar.html's clause when the arc completes).

FAMILY 1 — DONE (e561842ce): seed_root's LowerFunction/PlanEntryDispatch pushes proven always-coalesced, deleted.
FAMILY 2 — DONE (1ab96d652): seed_activation's AnalyzeActivation push proven redundant (co-demanded by every demand-map arm that reaches it), deleted. seed_root's twin found load-bearing ONLY because the bare scheduler lacked a demand mechanism -- named as family 3's gap, not blessed.
FAMILY 3 — DONE (folded 2026-07-02, three-lane audited PASS/PASS/PASS): the scheduler now demands-on-stall. World::demand_fact_producer (the fact->producer map, unified from the two token-identical production copies + test copy, ~130 duplicate lines deleted); World::demand_root_entry_analyses (every submitted root is a standing demand for its entry activation's analysis -- keyed by the DERIVED activation key, re-evaluated per drain so mid-session key changes re-ignite; has_run-gated so ignition fires once and revisions arrive via wakes); World::next_ready_job (drain -> expand root demands -> pop); a strictly-at-drain stall pass with a drive-local stall_demanded suppression set (wholesale-cleared on any changed fact -- bounded: each re-demand costs at most one no-change re-run before re-suppression; audit measured demand_on_stall fires = 0 on healthy drives). seed_root's last push DELETED; the 19 previously-push-dependent tests pass with assertions unmodified; producer_pokes==0 product-path assertions hold. submit_root's enqueue(SeedRoot) stays as the single axiomatic external ignition. Job-trace counts statistically indistinguishable before/after (AnalyzeActivation 68-74 spread BOTH sides -- the .28.5 nondeterminism; 45v45 on 00181). Audit follow-ups routed: demand_on_stall event undocumented+bare -> fz-go4.18.30; wholesale stall_demanded clearing is bounded-but-blunt (per-fact clearing keyed on the waited fact would be tighter -- consider during a later family if stall churn ever measures nonzero).

FAMILY 4+ (remaining, consumers-backward, one commit per family): jobs/body.rs (~72 refs — DeriveTypeDef, ReifyGuardDispatch pushes from lowering), jobs/semantic.rs (~66), jobs/dispatch.rs, jobs/keying.rs, jobs/contract.rs, jobs/types.rs, jobs/source.rs, source_publish.rs, quoted_expander.rs, world.rs (incl. wait_for_function_definition's DefineFunction follow_up and require_activation_key_facts' gated DeriveRecursive/DeriveDispatchMask follow_ups, which seed_root still forwards on its early-return wait paths -- now mechanically convertible: the facts these pushes produce all have demand_fact_producer arms, so each site should become a bare wait and let the drain expansion demand the producer). Product-side jobs emit ZERO follow_ups already. With family 3's mechanism in place the conversion recipe is uniform: replace wait+push pairs with bare waits; the scheduler's demand-on-stall covers first-run ignition; prove per family with static producer/wait-graph reasoning (job-trace counts are noisy per .28.5 -- do not use raw count diffs as the primary proof).

TELEMETRY GAP: pull-based.html prescribes follow_ups=0/root_scans=0 session-level proof. Add an aggregate follow-up-emission counter (or extend the session-finished event) before declaring the final family complete.

WATCH ITEMS: (1) semantic.rs:1255-1258 demands DefineModule(protocol) while waiting on ProtocolDispatch — resolve the real producer relationship during migration; (2) the coalesced-telemetry channel conflates agenda-dedupe with standing-conclusion suppression (scheduler.rs) — split the observability when this lands.

DONE = rg shows zero production follow_up emissions; JobEffects::follow_up field deleted; the .18.19 coalesce screen deleted; scheduler wake paths = changed-revision only plus the one submit_root ignition; docs updated (fact-engine.md drops 'legacy jobs may enqueue follow-ups'; northstar.html's tolerance clause updated). Sequencing: fz-go4.18.31 (AnalyzeActivation churn batching) AFTER the families touching jobs/semantic.rs land, to avoid same-file churn.

comments.text: STARTING INVENTORY from the .18.19 removable-code audit (2026-07-02, at 424b2ae6a): (1) FIRST REMOVAL, proof complete: seed_root's LowerFunction + PlanEntryDispatch follow_ups (root.rs:75-76) are provably ALWAYS-COALESCED — the concluding branch requires Recursive+DispatchMask facts, whose producers (keying.rs:148-152 -> body.rs:287; keying.rs:84-90 -> dispatch.rs:169) must therefore have concluded; first-run demand already lives in DeriveRecursive/DeriveDispatchMask; change waves handle re-runs. Safe to delete as this arc's first family (own commit). (2) KEEP-classified: root.rs:77/:112 AnalyzeActivation (genuine first-run demand for a just-minted activation); ALL other emissions are absence-gated wait+demand pairs (semantic.rs:219/1257/1301/1492/1647/2265, dispatch, body, keying, source, world.rs:2094/2102, quoted_expander, source_publish) — these are the wait-implies-demand conversion targets. (3) Product-side jobs (artifact/runtime_demand/transport/backend/native) emit ZERO follow_ups already. (4) Minor: the coalesced telemetry channel conflates agenda-dedupe (scheduler.rs:257) with standing-conclusion suppression (scheduler.rs:228-232) — split the observability when this arc lands. (5) Watch item from the cross-lane note: semantic.rs:1255-1258 demands DefineModule(protocol) while waiting on ProtocolDispatch — the one site where a follow_up forced a concluded job's re-run as a wait-unblocking mechanism; resolve its real producer relationship during migration.

title: Migrate the semantic layer off follow_up: work runs only via waits (pull) or changed-revision wakes
